content: Task ledger update: Plan LLM model lifecycle and freshness audit. Created docs/plans/2026-05-30-llm-model-lifecycle-and-freshness-plan.md. Findings: council/scout roles are not currently fixed model personas; practical model selection routes through Charon provider/model config and Hermes Agent bridge targets. Current live local models include Qwen3.5-9B-Q4_K_M and Qwen_Qwen3.5-4B-Q6_K, with edge_backbone defaulting to Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_XL. Next task is a read-only M1 inventory and hardcoded-model audit before any download/stage/switch automation.
